fields.title: First set
fields.description: The column of the first data input table which contains the elements of the first set.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Operation
fields.description: The set operation to perform on the selected sets.

fields.title: Second set
fields.description: The column of the second data input table which contains the elements of the second set.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Skip missing values
fields.description:
All missing values will be skipped during computation thus the result set contains no missing value
elements.

fields.title: Enable hiliting
fields.description:
If enabled, the hiliting of a set entry row will hilite all rows of this set entry in other views.
Depending on the number of rows, enabling this feature might consume a lot of memory.
